Decode3NN->finePC128->64->concat64skip->Linear128->64; repeat3NN->finePC64->32->concat32skip->Linear64->32. Head32->128->4.
recipe.normalization: WeightNet hidden8/8 and PointConv mixing output use per-edge/per-point nonaffineLN thenReLU; WeightNet final16 ReLU. Density MLP1->16ReLU->1sigmoid has noLN/BN. Lift/head hidden and skipfusion ReLU, finalfield linear.

No cross-step latent cache or repeated whole-point encoding per readout chunk.

Perquery ratio p_neighbor^-1/max_neighbor(p^-1), trainable1->16ReLU->1sigmoid; finite-neighbor KDE adaptation, not wholepoint KDE or FEM measure.
